assets.label: Build model parcel sketch
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Raster parcel feasibility artwork inside the active Parcel sketch dossier tab
Primary request: Use case: productivity-visual. Asset type: website card illustration for a residential construction financing landing page. Primary request: create an on-brand parcel feasibility sketch asset for FairLend's Parcel sketch tab, showing a top-down residential lot, buildable envelope, main multiplex massing, rear laneway-suite option, setback guides, frontage tick marks, and professional feasibility markups. Scene/backdrop: clean planning-desk blueprint sheet, no surrounding page UI or browser chrome. Subject: a single urban infill parcel diagram with lot boundary, soft blueprint grid, dimension ticks, buildable-area overlay, main building rectangle, rear suite pad, driveway/lane hint, and a few small lender/permit review marks. Style/medium: refined editorial technical illustration, premium financial/property-consulting brand, crisp vector-like drafting lines rendered as a raster image. Composition/framing: landscape rectangle, centered diagram, generous padding, readable at small card size, slight paper texture, no perspective distortion. Lighting/mood: calm, analytical, high-end advisory, clear and pragmatic. Color palette: warm ivory paper, pale blueprint blue, deep ink navy, muted teal, restrained FairLend green accents, small electric lime highlights. Materials/textures: subtle paper grain, fine drafting linework, translucent buildable-area washes. Text: none. Constraints: no words, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no people, no photoreal house photo, no screenshot UI, no browser frame, no cast shadow outside the asset.
Input images: the crop is a reference image only. Generate a brand-new standalone asset; do not copy crop pixels.
Composition/framing: match the reference crop's subject, angle, aspect ratio, and visual weight.
Constraints: remove neighboring-page contamination, occluding unrelated assets, webpage framing, and collage leftovers.
Transparency/background: Generate as a clean standalone rectangular image asset.
Avoid: crop output, screenshot, full page mockup, browser frame, watermark, placeholder, unrelated typography.
assets.negative_prompt: words, numbers, logo, watermark, people, photoreal house photo, screenshot UI, browser chrome, generic stock blueprint
